Getting here

Downtown Buckley, right on Main.

  1. Call ahead if you're in a hurry

    Takeout orders go in over the phone and are ready at the counter.

  2. Park on Main or in the lot

    Street parking out front, plus a lot — the door is the one with the street number lettered on the glass.

  3. Eat in the brick room

    Long shared tables, chandeliers and room for the whole family. Or take it home.
